name: alpha-language
description: Syntax highlighting and live diagnostics for the Alpha polyhedral language (.alpha), backed by alpha-rs's alpha-syntax/alpha-model front end.

alpha.nativeLibraryPaths.description: Extra directories to search for libisl/libgmp shared libraries at runtime, if they aren't found on the default system library search path (e.g. a non-Homebrew/non-apt install). Prepended to DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH (macOS) or LD_LIBRARY_PATH (Linux) before the native analyzer loads. Requires a window reload to take effect.

scripts.build:native: npm --prefix native install && npm --prefix native run build
